sourceChecks.locator: National Institute of Korean Language report, PDF pp. 79–80 (web lines 1586–1625): describes construction and verification of a 3-million-word Korean subject zero-anaphora corpus; spoken subjects are often unrealized or abbreviated.
sourceChecks.finding: Supports that Korean permits frequent unexpressed subjects and documents a verified subject-zero corpus. It does not establish all object anaphora or the entry's discourse-resolution rules.
